name_reason: Compliant data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> name: domain=audio, descriptor=sfx_dig_driver_handle accurately reflects purpose (AIL DIG digital-SFX driver handle) and data kind (handle/opaque pointer). No Ghidra address residue; no domain ID to preserve.
purpose: AIL (Miles Sound System) DIG driver handle for digital sound-effect playback; installed once at boot via AIL_install_DIG_INI and used as the opaque dig_driver argument to AIL_allocate_sample_handle for the two SFX sample channels.
logic_summary: Zero-init BSS pointer slot. main @0x25C32 stores AIL_install_DIG_INI() (NULL if no DIG hardware). On non-NULL it sets data_fd2_audio_sfx_driver_available_flag @0x53EF1 = 1 and allocates two sample handles: channel-0 (sfx_sample_handle_0 @0x53EE4) reuses the install return still live in EAX @0x25C42, channel-1 (sfx_sample_handle_1 @0x53EE8) re-reads the slot @0x25C50. Held until AIL_shutdown at program exit; never freed during runtime.
element_semantics: Single scalar pointer/handle: opaque AIL DIG driver handle returned by AIL_install_DIG_INI; 0 means no DIG driver installed.
comment_original_issue: src comment said 'kept uint32 to match the handle width' while the declaration is 'void *' (inconsistent with the actual type and with the void* sibling BGM-handle comment), and carried process-narrative ('the byte_data size hint was wrong -- caller width is dword, not byte'). Lifecycle/address detail (write 0x25C32, read 0x25C50, EAX-reuse 0x25C42) was accurate.
notes: Type declaration confirmed 'void *data_fd2_audio_sfx_dig_driver_handle;' (src line 858); datatype hint 'undefined4' matches 4-byte pointer width. Two effective reads of the handle (EAX-reuse for ch0, explicit memory read at 0x25C50 for ch1) verified via disasm 0x25C2A-0x25C5E; xref-to list flags only the explicit memory READ at 0x25C50 plus the WRITE at 0x25C32. AIL_install_DIG_INI @0x38D3B (returns int) and AIL_allocate_sample_handle(void*) @0x38F80 confirmed. Ghidra data plate had been stored in PRE_COMMENT (wrong field per project_ghidra_data_plate_mechanism) with stale 'fd2_main' naming; moved to PLATE_COMMENT, corrected to 'main', cleared PRE. FD2.LE saved.
